GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 3 Lengths 800m 6th 5 Lengths home turn Hard Ridden 8th rail gone 400m # weak/gone 400m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1200m was steadied for a number of strides after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat handy 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off, plodded home # weak run home

Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length Two Wide , Drifted Back to Turn then Hooked Out to 2 Lengths 3 Wide , Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Jockey permitted to ride 1.0kg overweight.] # no real excuses

jumped awkwardly . Rolled fwd & shared lead on inside until Settled Down behind leader on rail (2L from lead). Tracked eader on inside midrace & held up on inside @ 550m. Pushed to quicken on inside (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid out @ 250m & faded in last 150m. # didn't finish off

Jumped only fairly missing start 1 length and Settled Down last 6.5 Lengths on fence, little change to 6 Lengths 2-3 Wide turning, steered to centre of track Straightening Up and made no ground in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. App. jockey stated it began only fairly, settled further back than anticipated, travelled fairly early/middle stages and ground its way to the line from its rearward position. She noted its form suggests it races best when able to settle more prominently. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # slow out/got back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Steadied after improving onto heels near 800m. App stated mount began only fairly & settled further back than anticipated. App stated mount travelled fairly in e&m stages & ground to line down the straight from is rearward position, unable to make the required ground on the leading division. App noted that her mounts form suggests it races best when able to settle in a more prominent position. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Made Some Ground to 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated it was obliged to race three Wide in midfield, was under pressure at 600m and was disappointing to the line. He added its form suggests it appreciates more give in the ground. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # wide/weakened badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When qst, rdr std that from the widest barrier his mount was obliged to race three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages in a midfield position. Added his mnt was under pressure from the 600m and was disappointing in its run to the line. Also std the gelding form suggests it appreciates more give in the ground than that today. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok landed box seat 2 Lengths off, limited room turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, took over 200m and drew clear # had run/too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped shortly after the start. Steadied after improving onto heels rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Wide trailing a half length, in Two Wide by the 950m, held together much same to turn 1 length Two Wide , Lost Ground in straight. # worked a bit early
Jumped Well , camped 3 Wide No Cover 3rd early then decided to take the lead 1000m. 1 length Clear To The Turn . Joined then Just shaded past 200m. Never Stopped Trying though # game in defeat
Jumped Ok , sat Outside Leader .5 Lengths 1000m, put under pressure when pace went on from the 600m, Headed before turn but battled on well under riding and held minor placing # held minor spot

Jumped okay & Settled Down Four Wide trailing a half length, pressed on and into Two Wide Lead by then1200m, went clear and crossed mid-race, Held Together in front & led 1.75 Lengths turning, shifted out to centre of track after Straightening Up , narrowly Headed at 160m but kept battling to post # battled on ok

Began well. Rolled fwd to lead on rail by 2 Lengths early . Held unchallenged lead on inside midrace & quickened @ 500m. Pushed to quicken on inside (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured on rail @ 300m & fought on until over-run in last 75m. # Led - tried hard.
